description: Gear up with the Waveguard Waterproof Duffle Bag. Engineered with a heavy-duty three-layer waterproof vinyl tarpaulin shell and waterproof zipper, the watertight duffle bag ensures your gear and essentials remain secure, organized, and dry. As part of Rothco’s Waveguard collection, this waterproof bag is fully submersible and meets IPX7 waterproof standards, ideal for water sport enthusiasts, outdoor adventurers, and avid travelers. Tension-Locked Waterproof Zipper: For optimal performance and protection, our Waveguard bags feature waterproof zippers that are designed with a secure zipper seal that increases tension. To ensure a full closure, always zip the waterproof dry bag completely to maintain waterproof performance. All-in-One Storage: The dry bag features a large main compartment with a waterproof zipper and an inner mesh accessory pouch for keeping your possessions dry. The waterproof duffle has a 20L capacity and measures 19 inch x 9 inch overall. Utility at the Forefront: These kayak bags come equipped with a removable and adjustable shoulder strap and dual web carry handles with handle wrap for a comfortable carry while exploring the great outdoors. These travel duffle bags feature MOLLE loops for gear attachment and a grab handle for quick and easy handling. Adventure Ready: Whether you’re on a rafting trip or spending a day out on the beach, our Waveguard waterproof bags allow you to keep your outdoor gear protected and are perfect for kayaking, canoeing, boating, camping, and hiking.
